newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - BR Distribuidora cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BR Distribuidora cut.

text.p: Salomon Brothers and its local associate Banco Patrimonio said Tuesday they had downgraded their recommendation on Brazilian fuel distributor Petrobras BR Distribuidora to hold from buy.

In a report, Patrimonio analyst Pedro Martins Jr. also said he had cut his 1997 earnings per share (EPS) estimate for the firm to 3.23 reais from 3,.775 reais and its 1998 EPS forecast to 3.64 reais from 4.40 reais.
He cited lower-than-expected second quarter financial results for the firm.
The company reported second-quarter net earnings of 28 million reais compared with 31 million reais in the same period last year.
Martins said he lowered his estimates due to lower-than-expected sales volume growth and deterioration of operational profits per unit sold.
The firm's preferred share closed off 1.18 percent at 33.00 reais in Sao Paulo.
